cancel-own.description: Also cancel the run this job belongs to, which ends its unfinished jobs at the first failure

cancel.name: cancel the rest of the runs of this commit

steps.name: Run the base commit's copy of the cancel script
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git cat-file -e "${BASE_SHA}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$BASE_SHA" 2>/dev/null || true
if git show "${BASE_SHA}:.github/scripts/ci/cancel-others.sh" >"$RUNNER_TEMP/others.sh" 2>/dev/null; then
  bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/others.sh"
else
  echo "::warning::the base commit has no cancel script; nothing is cancelled"
fi

name: Cancel the other runs of a failed commit (reusable)
